verdict.rationale: Buzz is architected so that its underlying Nostr relay protocol IS the API — third-party clients can connect directly via NIP-29/NIP-42 (buzz-supp-nostr-open-protocol), and the CLI documents parity for channels, repos, workflows, gifs, and protection rules (buzz-docs-5..8), with agents explicitly able to open repos, review code, run workflows, edit canvases, and join huddles (buzz-gh-2). However there's no formal OpenAPI/swagger spec (buzz-probe-2 404s) or llms.txt (buzz-probe-1), and some richer UI surfaces (frame-anchored video comments, huddles, feed personalization) aren't confirmed to have CLI/API equivalents. Missing for 10: a published OpenAPI/REST spec confirming full UI-feature parity, and explicit API coverage for video annotation/huddle/feed features.
